original_card.question: Can a new local cost interface change the deficit-to-recursive-cost ratio beyond current packing?
methods: Propose a changed helper inventory and derive an optimistic exact moment.
Design a small completed instance and independently verify its endpoint and rank bill.
original_card.acceptance_gate: A new physically realizable contract outside the frozen catalogue whose per-call profile, screened with ceiling.ceiling(), beats the selected word's packing ceiling; a lower cap does not establish identical circuitry or order attainable optima, and is insufficient to pass the stronger-budget target under this model. A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

first_step.inspect: Read the selected word's per-call local profile, its packing ceiling and the lever table; run levers.py for the ideal budget of the lever you target.
first_step.scope: Positive control and planning budget only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Before any synthesis, write the candidate per-call local profile (and centre charge / unpaid coordinates if changed) and screen it with ceiling.ceiling(); reject it if even the ideal ceiling does not beat the selected word's by your stated margin.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Packing of the selected word is capped at +0.87% (ceiling model); only a lower local excess spend or a changed coverage law raises the cap.

actual_scope: Prove general-dimensional odd-type fitting-rank bounds, with h5/h6 copy-cost, rank-slack and orbit77 identity-assembly consequences for arbitrary finite multiplicities.
scope_change_reason: The live small-unit note explicitly requests an orbit77 assembly test. A triangular selector and symmetry averaging give a scoped obstruction before native construction. The same affine-flag argument extends to general ambient dimensions; this is a theorem extension within the same fitting model, not a new helper inventory or current-word packing refinement.
bottleneck_link: A new unit could change both supplier budgets, but its local projectors must complete a fitting identity and satisfy the actual bit-window rank. The new bounds reject the beta-five-only low-cost/rank-additive route and tighten paired-window admissibility.
selection_note: Explicit handoff-first override to the orbit77 reopening question; retrieved the named new-helper card after checking current priorities and live overlap.
stop_rule: Prove the finite selectors, arbitrary-multiplicity averaging and exact factorization consequences; reject any unsupported scope extension. Stop this assembly route at the lower bound, without launching a larger search or claiming mixed dictionaries are impossible.
evidence: Written arbitrary-field/multiplicity and general-dimension proof; separate h5/h6 implementations; finite general geometry through dimension eight; repeated-port rank fixtures; retained projector positive control; nine semantic/source controls. Validation status is recorded in EVIDENCE.md.

expansion_decision: Stop beta-five-only designs below x=.45 and rank-additive rank16 identity assemblies under the stated odd-type mask. Keep mixed charges, lower-rank totals, sufficiently non-additive assemblies and changed masks open. Require a complete paired invoice before further construction.
